comparison.objective: Route and staple a cable at prescribed endpoint and spacing intervals; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable alignment and repeated staple placement versus hex-key engagement, fine rotary adjustment, tightening, and impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Staples within 6 cm of ends and no more than 20 cm apart versus energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Fastener placement along a cable does not test adjustable damping behavior.
